themes.title: Pointers and memory
mainQuestions: Walk me through how your linked list is built. What does each node point to?
What happens to the memory your program allocates once it is finished with the list?
criteria: Student can describe the node structure and how the next pointer links nodes
Student knows allocated nodes must be freed and where this happens in their code

themes.title: Edge cases
mainQuestions: What does your code do if the list is empty when you try to remove an element?
criteria: Student can explain the empty-list check or admits the case is not handled
